temperature_column_descriptions: Burner set to maximum power for 180 s, half power for 390 s, flipped burgers, half power until meat temperature reached well done temperature of 77 C (at most 600 s).
Broiled for 1122 s (10 % longer than the time for the meat temperature to reach a safe temperature of 71 C).

Burner set to half power, then maximum power at 190 s to preheat oil to ~190 C. At 384 s, chicken legs added to pan and cooked for 4 minutes on each side for a total of 18.5 minutes, which was 10 % longer than the time it took for the meat temperature to reach 74 °C.

Burner set to maximum power to preheat oil to ~190 C. At 280 s, frozen fries were added and burner power set to half. Trying to maintain a pan temperature of ~190 C, at 350 s burner power was increased to maximum, and at 622 s, burner power was set to half. After 15 minutes of frying, when the color of the fries had turned medium brown, the burner was set to maximum power until the food ignited.
